entry_id: emg2qwerty/fidetype P11-01 causal ring-TCN CTC (personalised) + P11-11 intended-text decoder (key beam 64, Tatoeba 6-gram LM, train lexicon, OOV gate) + P11-12 no-signal gate/intended-text guard, sentence commits, learned score (P11-12 arm SL)

decoder.name: fidetype P11-01 causal ring-TCN CTC (personalised) + P11-11 intended-text decoder (key beam 64, Tatoeba 6-gram LM, train lexicon, OOV gate) + P11-12 no-signal gate
decoder.weights_licence: not released (CC BY-NC-SA data: research only)
training_data: emg2qwerty: generic model on 100 other users; personal fine-tuning on the train sessions of each of the 8 users (never the track val or test session)
LM: Tatoeba English (no emg2qwerty text); lexicon: words of the track-train sessions; LM weight and length bonus tuned on the calibration tuning part (P11-11)
decoder.training_regime: personalised (fine-tuned on earlier sessions of the same user)

policy.name: intended-text guard, sentence commits, learned score (P11-12 arm SL)
policy.description: fidetype.trust.calibrate on 1224 track-val prompts of the same 8 users, alpha 0.05, delta 0.1, commit threshold 0.61; acoustic no-signal gate (greedy keys >= 15, 1.84 <= keys/s <= 17.28) fitted on the calibration tuning part

basis.shuffled: input level: the test session EMG features time-shuffled (seeded per session, P11-09 windows), then the same decoder, gate and guard
basis.zeros: input level: zero EMG (every band at log(1e-6)), then the same decoder, gate and guard

guarantee.scope: marginal over test prompts pooled over the 8 users; exchangeable val / test sessions; wrong = committed intended text differs from the truth intended text

correction_rule.name: rewrite
correction_rule.formula: 2 s + 0.7895 s/char * len(truth) per wrong commit

safe_wpm.no_bci_note: gaze typing of every sentence at 20 chars/min (the eWPM reference)

safe_wpm_v02.definition_status: adopted 2026-11-22: the headline metric (prefix credit + the aac-gaze-v1 reading cost); safe-wpm/0.1 stays selectable with metric_version='0.1' for old numbers

correction_rule.name: rewrite
correction_rule.formula: 2 s + 0.7895 s/char * len(truth) per wrong commit
correction_rule.prefix: a wrong prefix of k words costs the penalty of the first k words of the truth

reading_cost.formula: 0.5 s + 0.3 s/word * k per commit (right or wrong); prefix commits with fewer than 1 word(s) count as no commit
reading_cost.note: the adopted safe-wpm/0.2 reading cost (2026-11-22) is 0.5 s + 0.3 s/word per commit, minimum prefix 1 word; other values give a sensitivity variant

safe_wpm_v02.no_bci_note: gaze typing of every sentence at 20 chars/min (the eWPM reference)

notes: RESEARCH ONLY (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 data). Target intended_text (intended-text/1): the guard commits the intended text, so truth and outputs are compared after Backspace is applied. Offline decisions on full prompt windows (no latency claim). P11-12 decisions, scored by P11-13.

Target intended_text (intended-text/1): truth and outputs are compared after Backspace is applied, so CER is the character error rate of the intended text and the no-BCI reference is gaze typing of the intended text. Not ranked with raw-key entries.
RESEARCH ONLY: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 data. Results and weights are non-commercial.

track_info.title: Wrist sEMG touch typing (emg2qwerty, Meta) - RESEARCH ONLY

target.name: intended_text
target.rule: Backspace applied (registry.keycodes_to_intended_text, rule intended-text/1): a character key appends, Backspace removes the last character if any, Enter is ignored, then runs of spaces are joined and the ends stripped
